objective: Define LSS-07 Component Family Taxonomy & Decomposition Profile Library. Build reusable governed component-family and decomposition-profile content for appropriate object domains—such as weapons, armor, tools, electronics, machinery, vehicles, mecha, ships, bases/facilities, magical devices and constructs—using explicit retained catalog/source evidence and the LSS-02 schema. Families may organize authored profiles, aliases, compatibility-owner references and provenance/search metadata, but must never assert universal anatomy, mandatory part counts, default yields or cross-category equivalence merely from names/categories/common sense.

completed_verified LSS-06 extraction engine contract and evidence requirements
retained explicit salvage/component evidence, especially Mecha and Hazards/Traps catalogs plus heterogeneous vehicle/computer/EVA/base/spacecraft fields
MIB-14 compatibility authority and MIB-12 crafting/repair boundary
completion_gate: A provenance-bearing searchable reference library defines reusable component-family taxonomy plus explicit decomposition profiles across multiple representative object domains, distinguishes family classification from actual authored anatomy, carries source/catalog evidence and compatibility-owner references, supports aliases/tags/reverse profile lookup without inventing outputs, and provides enough explicit fixed/source-rule quantity evidence for LSS-06 where source data supports it while preserving unknowns otherwise. Profiles validate under LSS-02 and prove that same-family members may have different slots/yields. No live extraction, repair/reassembly, inventory, compatibility, economy or biological-harvest owner truth is added.
